mentions.name: smolvm
mentions.description: A replacement for Docker focused on better isolation and more lightweight resource utilization. It is an embeddable sandbox, positioned as "the sqlite of VMs".
mentions.problem: Existing container solutions like Docker lack stronger isolation and use more resources than necessary.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a replacement for docker focused on better isolation and more lightweight resource utilization.

It's a sandbox that you can embed ala the sqlite of VM's.
mentions.author: binsquare

mentions.name: smol machines
mentions.description: A sandboxing primitive that works locally and remotely to enable "branchable compute": users can checkpoint, branch, and roll back entire virtual machines, like git but applied to the whole computer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building smol machines, a new sandboxing primitive that works locally/remotely to introduce "branchable compute".
mentions.author: binsquare

mentions.name: smolvm
mentions.description: A lightweight, portable virtual machine that simplifies or replaces the need for containers.
mentions.source_excerpt: A lightweight ,portable virtual machine that simplifies/replaces need for containers.
mentions.author: binsquare

mentions.name: smolvm
mentions.description: A new VM/container hybrid primitive that combines the isolation of a VM with the speed and flexibility of containers; the open-source foundation of smol machines' cloud infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building it on top of a new primitive called smolvm: a hybrid that combines isolation of VM with speed and flexibility of containers.

https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm
